_comment: Every OpenFOAM release the application knows how to provision and drive (§3.4).
No version number appears anywhere in application code (NFR-M3) — this file is
the only place they live, and it ships over the content channel independently
of the application, so a new ESI release is supported without an app release.
'verified' records whether the entry has been exercised against a real install.
The others are transcribed from the published packaging and are expected to
work, but saying so plainly is cheaper than a support ticket that discovers it.
The macOS entries describe a Homebrew *cask* — the gerlero tap distributes an
OpenFOAM.app bundle whose payload is a disk image mounted on demand, not the
formula PRD §3.3 assumes. 'cask_version' is the app's own version, which is
independent of the OpenFOAM release it carries.
